candidate.researchQuestion: What trust boundaries must a resumable digital employee enforce when it imports prior history and later accepts a human confirmation for a tool action?
candidate.title: Resumable Agents Need Separate Trust Gates for History, Protocol State, and Approval
candidate.title_zh: 可恢复 Agent 需要把历史、协议状态与人工批准分成不同信任门

sections.heading: Imported history is data before it is authority
sections.heading_zh: 导入历史首先是数据，不是权威

sections.heading: Occurrence binding solves reference integrity, not authorization
sections.heading_zh: 动作实例绑定解决的是指向正确，不是谁有权批准

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected ADK change validates client-supplied initialization events before session creation and rejects framework-owned protocol events while admitting ordinary history.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选 ADK 变更会在 Session 创建前校验客户端初始化事件，拒绝框架自有协议事件，同时允许普通历史。

evidenceClaims.claim: Confirmation resolution binds a confirmation to a matching historical original tool occurrence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 确认解析会把 Confirmation 绑定到匹配的历史原始 Tool Occurrence。

evidenceClaims.claim: History admission, protocol-state admission, occurrence binding and approver authorization should remain separate trust gates.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 历史准入、协议状态准入、动作实例绑定和确认者授权应保持为不同信任门。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument is complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering question.

candidate.researchQuestion: What must a multi-agent architecture make explicit so a delegated remote task can pause, resume, finish and return control without confusing transport termination with successful work?
candidate.title: Delegated Agent Work Needs a Return Contract, Not Just a Transport
candidate.title_zh: 多 Agent 委派需要返回合同，而不只是传输结束

sections.heading: One identity should survive the delegated lifecycle
sections.heading_zh: 同一个身份应贯穿完整委派生命周期

sections.heading: A semantic finish is stronger than end-of-stream
sections.heading_zh: 语义完成比 End-of-stream 更强

sections.heading: Cross-framework composition requires more contracts
sections.heading_zh: 跨框架委派还需要额外兼容合同

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected ADK task mode reuses one coordinator FunctionCall identity as the delegated task isolation scope.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选 ADK Task Mode 复用一个 Coordinator FunctionCall Identity 作为委派任务 Isolation Scope。

evidenceClaims.claim: Task completion uses explicit finish evidence whose output must satisfy the declared output schema, while failure classes remain distinct.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Task Completion 使用显式 Finish Evidence，输出必须满足声明的 Output Schema，失败类别保持区分。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reliable delegated work needs both stable occurrence identity and a semantic return contract.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 可靠委派工作需要稳定 Occurrence Identity 与 Semantic Return Contract 两类合同。

projectRelevance.rationale: The delegation analysis is complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: No separate community framing adds enough value beyond the complete Research Center analysis.

candidate.researchQuestion: What ownership facts must an agent runtime separate when background tool work may outlive the agent that created it during handoff or teardown?
candidate.title: Safe Agent Handoff Requires Separate Routing and Effect Ownership
candidate.title_zh: 安全的 Agent 交接必须分开路由所有权与外部效果所有权

sections.heading: Handoff is an ownership transfer
sections.heading_zh: Handoff 本质上是所有权转移

sections.heading: Cancellation requested is not the same as task stopped
sections.heading_zh: 已请求取消，不等于 Task 已停止

sections.heading: External effects require provider-specific evidence
sections.heading_zh: 外部效果需要 Provider-specific Evidence

evidenceClaims.claim: The selected ADK change makes a live agent run responsible for streaming and non-blocking background tasks and invokes cleanup before handoff.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 所选 ADK 变更让 Live Agent Run 对 Streaming 与 Non-blocking Background Task 负责，并在 Handoff 前执行 Cleanup。

evidenceClaims.claim: Registry retirement prevents stale streaming tools from receiving future live input but does not prove underlying task termination.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Registry Retirement 阻止陈旧 Streaming Tool 接收未来 Live Input，但不证明底层 Task 已终止。

evidenceClaims.claim: Handoff safety requires separate evidence for execution ownership, routing ownership and external-effect ownership.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Handoff Safety 需要分别证明 Execution Ownership、Routing Ownership 与 External-effect Ownership。

projectRelevance.rationale: The handoff argument is general to asynchronous agent runtimes and needs no first-party project insertion.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already preserves the necessary mechanism and evidence boundaries.
